ALTO 4.4 schema fixtures
========================

These files let the OCR export tests validate generated ALTO with `xmllint --schema`.
They are vendored unmodified; nothing in src/ reads them.

NOTICE: alto-4-4.xsd and xlink.xsd are third-party schema documents, byte-for-byte as published
(hashes below). They are used only by the test suite (tests/helpers/xml-oracle.ts) to validate
generated ALTO and are not part of the shipped product or its build.

alto-4-4.xsd
  Source:   https://www.loc.gov/standards/alto/v4/alto-4-4.xsd (Library of Congress, ALTO Editorial Board)
  Version:  4.4 (the file's own "Version 4.4" header and version="4.4" attribute)
  Fetched:  2026-10-06
  SHA-256:  5564fd29d2dd090d8102b8a0aa081906afd677cd5ecc632312e56f21ea14702b
  License:  The file header states: "This document is available under the Creative Commons
            Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). The ALTO Editorial Board has
            waived all rights to it worldwide under copyright law with confirmation of the original
            creating authors, including all related and neighboring rights, to the extent allowed
            by law." It is therefore not CC0 as such; the waiver plus the attribution below satisfy
            the terms. Attribution: ALTO: Analyzed Layout and Text Object, ALTO Editorial Board,
            Library of Congress.

xlink.xsd
  Source:   https://www.loc.gov/standards/mets/xlink.xsd (Library of Congress, "METS XLink Schema, v. 2,
            Nov. 15, 2004")
  Fetched:  2026-10-06
  SHA-256:  f1f5bb6003165cdd8f6c1fcc32f8fd1f965e1681010f3b9806d9460bcffa8a3c
  License:  Published by the Library of Congress, a U.S. government work with no license header
            (public domain in the United States).
  Why:      alto-4-4.xsd imports the XLink namespace from
            http://www.loc.gov/standards/xlink/xlink.xsd, which now answers 404, and it references the
            `xlink:simpleLink` attribute group. This is the Library of Congress schema that defines that
            group in the same namespace. Tests map the dead URL to this file with an XML catalog
            (XML_CATALOG_FILES) and run xmllint with --nonet, so no network access is needed.
